message:
C'mon, Rob, that one's not potty-mouthed at all:

> There once was a man from Nantucket
> Who kept all his cash in a bucket
> His daughter, named Nan,
> Ran off with a man,
> And as for the bucket, Nantucket.:-)

Now if you want potty-mouthed poetry, there's [this wonderful example](http://www.vroma.org/~hwalker/VRomaCatullus/016x.html). But the best example ever of a hilariously raunchy poem? [*The Miller's Tale*](http://www.luminarium.org/medlit/miller.htm). No contest.
